title: Mapovanie biotopov a druhov živočíchov vo vybraných ÚEV
description: Predmetom zákazky je zmapovanie vybraných biotopov a skupín živočíchov vo vybraných územiach európskeho významu (ďalej len "ÚEV") pre účely vypracovania dokumentov starostlivosti. Podrobný zoznam biotopov a vybraných skupín živočíšnych druhov, ktoré sú predmetom mapovania v jednotlivých ÚEV je v Prílohe č. 1 súťažných podkladov. Je členený po jednotlivých častiach zákazky, ktorými sú lesné biotopy, nelesné biotopy, mäkkýše, hmyz, ryby, obojživelníky, netopiere. Súčasťou zoznamu je rozdelenie ÚEV podľa priorít od 1 po 3, pričom v roku 2026 je potrebné zrealizovať mapovanie v ÚEV s prioritou 1 a min. v 2/3 ÚEV s prioritou 2 a v roku 2027 realizovať mapovanie vo zvyšných ÚEV s prioritou 2 a v ÚEV s prioritou 3. Podrobný opis predmetu zákazky tvorí prílohu č. 1 súťažných podkladov. Predmetom mapovania je výskyt cieľových druhov živočíchov (netopiere) v územiach európskeho významu (ÚEV). Zhotoviteľ identifikuje potenciálne biotopy týchto druhov, vytvára inventarizačné lokality podľa metodiky a vykonáva terénny zber údajov vrátane sprievodných druhov. Výstupom sú GIS vrstvy biotopov a lokalít, údaje v systéme KIMS a správy s odhadom veľkosti populácie a návrhom opatrení. Podrobná špecifikácia je uvedená v súťažných podkladoch. Predmetom zákazky je terénne mapovanie lesných biotopov podľa metodiky ŠOP SR a Katalógov biotopov SR, so spracovaním výstupov vo forme GIS vrstvy, databázy a fotodokumentácie. Výstupy budú obsahovať základné biotopové charakteristiky a budú odovzdávané na kontrolu objednávateľovi. Podrobná špecifikácia je uvedená v súťažných podkladoch. Zhotoviteľ zabezpečí mapovanie nelesných biotopov podľa metodiky ŠOP SR, s využitím podkladových GIS vrstiev a elektronických formulárov. Každý homogénny polygón biotopu bude zaznamenaný s ID, druhovým zložením, percentuálnym zastúpením a fotodokumentáciou. Výstupom je GIS vrstva, databáza a fotografie, ktoré sa odovzdávajú priebežne po ÚEV. Podrobná špecifikácia je uvedená v súťažných podkladoch. Predmetom mapovania je výskyt cieľových druhov živočíchov (hmyz) v územiach európskeho významu (ÚEV). Zhotoviteľ identifikuje potenciálne biotopy týchto druhov, vytvára inventarizačné lokality podľa metodiky a vykonáva terénny zber údajov vrátane sprievodných druhov. Výstupom sú GIS vrstvy biotopov a lokalít, údaje v systéme KIMS a správy s odhadom veľkosti populácie a návrhom opatrení. Podrobná špecifikácia je uvedená v súťažných podkladoch. title: INCUBED CALL FOR PROPOSAL: STANDARD CALL FOR PROPOSALS
description: The InCubed Element of the European Earth Watch Programme (InCubed) aims to accompany European economic operators in the rapid evolution of the Earth Observation market, both in Europe and globally. InCubed introduces a dedicated process within ESA Earth Observation programmes to strengthen and stimulate the development of near-to-market commercial initiatives in partnership with industry. Activities supported under InCubed include the development and/or demonstration of space assets (e.g. missions, instruments, prototype elements of EO constellations), innovative mission management solutions (including for future EO constellations), as well as the development of ground, data, and application platforms. InCubed targets commercial viability by the end of the activity (at least at minimum viable product level) and requires a substantial degree of innovation, i.e. the creation of new value within the EO commercial landscape. Commercial customer engagement is mandatory, with customers acting as beta testers and validators of the developed product or service. Customer engagement must be clearly demonstrated at both pitch and proposal stages, and letters of support or interest from potential customers are considered a strong asset. The scope of the proposed activities is defined by the economic operators themselves, in line with the objectives of InCubed. Two development cycles are available within InCubed, depending on the maturity of the concept: De-risking Cycle (typically starting from TRL 4), focusing on reducing technical and market risks;Product Development Cycle (typically starting from TRL 6), aiming at delivering a product ready for commercialisation. Under this Call for Proposals, economic operators are invited to submit their ideas via the OSIP (Open Space Innovation Platform) (ideas.esa.int), which serves as the entry point for the programme. The application process consists of the following step: Idea Pitch - Applicantssubmit and present a draft Outline proposal via OSIP to ESA (and potentially the relevant National Delegation(s)). Following a positive assessment, economic operators will be invited to submit a Proposal Part 2 (Full) in accordance with the established procedures and evaluation criteria. Activities supported under InCubed are based on a co-funding scheme, whereby economic operators contribute financially to the project, demonstrating commitment to and confidence in their business case.

title: BIOMASS GSE Test Cables
description:
The BIOMASS programme was selected as the 7th Earth Explorer mission in 
Spring 2013 in Graz, Austria. The overall objective of the mission is to 
reduce the uncertainty in the worldwide spatial distribution and dynamics 
of forest biomass in order to improve current assessments and future 
projections of the global carbon cycle.

The objective will be achieved by implementation of a P-band SAR mission, 
providing global maps of forest biomass stocks, forest disturbance and 
growth.

This notification of Intended Invitation To Tender concerns the procurement 
of Biomass GSE Test Cables by Airbus Defence and Space Ltd as Prime 
contractor of the Biomass project. The supplier selection will be made in 
accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.

The scope of this procurement covers the design, development, production,
testing and delivery of the GSE Test Cables.

The Ground Support Equipment (GSE) Test Cables are required to connect the 
necessary Special Check Out Equipment (SCOEs) with the Biomass Spacecraft 
to allow testing and verification. The cables will interface between SCOEs? 
(e.g. Power SCOE, RF SCOE) non-flight harness, and provide a flight quality 
connection to the Spacecraft during cleanroom testing and during 
environmental tests within a chamber. The test cables will be used to 
deliver: Power, RF and data depending on the SCOE.

In this framework, the present Invitation To Tender will be addressed to 
economic operators (including those deemed to act as subcontractors) whose 
registered office is established in such Member and Associated States 
which, by the time of the Contract award decision, will be a participating 
State in the ESA Biomass project. 

The following States are participating in the said Programme: Austria,
Belgium, Canada, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany,
Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, 
Romania, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

Tenderers are hereby informed that for this ITT, preference may be given to 
tenders containing a substantial involvement of economic operators 
registered in Austria, Belgium, Canada, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, 
Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania
, Sweden and Switzerland, provided that:

- the tenders will have been assessed of a good quality (weighted mark of 
at least 55);and

- as representing an acceptable combination between technical quality 
(including risk) and price.
